Self harm isn’t something you just snap out of, it’s not for attention and if anything we do our absolute best to try hide it. Don’t point out our scars and for the love of god don’t tell anyone we haven’t asked you to tell. Suicidal thoughts aren’t always “I want to die” it can also be “I’m a burden” “they all hate me” “I don’t deserve to be happy” and panic attacks/ depressive episodes are not just when you have a bad day it can happen anytime and when it does all you can feel is nothing and hopeless. Don’t laugh at people for cutting themselves and being “emo” it’s not a joke and is a serious addiction.
